column2: [intro]
I’ve got a heart like marshmallow, so soft and moldable,
Sweet words enchant me, it’s just so enjoyable.
I’m like clay in their hands, they twist and turn,
They take advantage, manipulate, with every churn.
I let myself be swayed, oh yes, I’m so hooked,
By all these smooth talkers who spin tales that are cooked.
I let myself be swayed, without even knowing,
That I’m the gullible one, always end up losing.
They sell me dreams, promises in cascade,
And me, the naive fool, I swallow them unafraid.
I’m like the cherry on the manipulator's cake,
They savor and delight, I’m their best fake.
I let myself be swayed, oh yes, I’m so hooked,
By all these con artists who drown me in their schemes.
I let myself be swayed, without even resisting,
I’m the puppet dancing to their persistent twisting.
[ solo ]
I let myself be swayed, oh yes, I’m so hooked,
By all these smooth talkers who spin tales that are cooked.
I let myself be swayed, without even knowing,
That I’m the gullible one, always end up losing.
[outro]
